emotional_tone: Calm, elegant, modern, airy, emotionally warm, and stress-reducing. A beautiful private command center for wedding planning, free of corporate spreadsheet aesthetics.

primary.description: Sage green. Used for primary actions, progress bars, and reassuring accents.

secondary.description: Dusty rose. Used for secondary highlights, romantic touches, and dream vision tags.

accent.description: Muted gold. Used sparingly for special highlights, icons, and "selected" states.

background.description: Warm ivory. The global background color, providing an airy and soft foundation.

surface.description: Pure white for cards and floating elements to stand out against the ivory background.

border.description: Soft stone neutral. Used for delicate borders around cards, inputs, and dividers.

text.description: Deep warm greys/browns instead of harsh black to maintain softness.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-light tracking-tight text-text-primary

examples: Still open — no need to decide just yet.
Your dream team is coming together.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary-hover rounded-full px-8 py-3 transition-all duration-300 font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-border text-text-primary hover:border-primary hover:text-primary rounded-full px-8 py-3 transition-all duration-300

cards.base: bg-surface rounded-2xl border border-border p-6 md:p-8 shadow-card transition-all duration-300

inputs.text: bg-background border border-border rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-text-primary focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary transition-all duration-300 placeholder:text-text-muted

tabs.list: inline-flex bg-background p-1 rounded-full border border-border
tabs.trigger: rounded-full px-6 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-text-secondary data-[state=active]:bg-surface data-[state=active]:text-primary data-[state=active]:shadow-sm transition-all

progress_bar.indicator: bg-primary h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-700 ease-out

icons.style: Subtle, thin stroke, emotionally warm. Use muted colors.

decorative_elements.florals: Subtle line-art botanicals or muted watercolor shapes placed in corners of the screen or empty states to reinforce the wedding theme.
decorative_elements.dividers: Use a subtle 1px dashed or dotted line (border-border) instead of solid lines to feel less corporate.

page_patterns.dashboard: Bento grid layout. Top row: greeting and progress. Middle: key stats (budget, vendors booked) in soft cards. Bottom: next actions list.
page_patterns.dream_vision: Masonry gallery or wide staggered cards mixing beautiful imagery with estimated budgets and assigned vendors. Focus on aesthetics and inspiration over numbers.
page_patterns.plan_builder: Guided wizard. Clean, progressive disclosure. One question/step at a time. Generous whitespace, large touch targets, live budget calculation on the side.
page_patterns.vendor_directory: Grid of soft cards. Badges for status (Shortlisted, Booked). Clear contact actions.
page_patterns.budget: Visual, reassuring cards. Use soft progress bars (sage green fill, stone track). No dense tables; break down costs into accordion rows.

hero_backgrounds.description: Rustic Italian farmhouse surrounded by cypress trees (perfect for La Locanda del Nocciolo vibe).

dream_vision_images.description: Dusty rose and dried floral bouquet, perfectly matching the aesthetic.
Elegant Turkish wedding corner setup with sage and rose accents, traditional rugs, brass lanterns.
White lanterns and candles on a table setting.

Watercolor live sketch of a couple on an easel.

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and setup Tailwind and Google Fonts (Cormorant Garamond and Manrope).
Configure Tailwind config with the custom colors provided above.
Do NOT use a standard table component for the budget or vendors. Use card grids, flex rows, and accordions to avoid the 'spreadsheet' feel.
Implement the Plan Builder as a multi-step wizard using state management. Calculate budget interactively.
Seed the app state with the provided context (Venue: La Locanda del Nocciolo, Florist: Symon Mattio, etc.).
Ensure the entire app maintains a light, airy, and emotionally reassuring tone.
